functional.title: Accounts and roles
functional.statement: Customer and provider roles are stored independently; staff permissions are separate.
functional.acceptance: Given an unauthenticated user, protected writes return 401. Given a provider without staff permission, moderation returns 403. Switching a UI role never grants a server permission.

functional.title: Create and edit a request
functional.statement: An owner supplies title, description, category, property type, city/district, desired date and optional KZT budget.
functional.acceptance: A valid request publishes once with an ID. Missing title/description/category or a past desired date is rejected. Once offers exist, a material edit invalidates active offers and requests resubmission.

functional.title: Request photos
functional.statement: An owner can attach up to five JPEG/PNG images, each no larger than 5 MB.
functional.acceptance: Unsupported content and oversized files are rejected server-side. Another customer cannot retrieve a private attachment by guessing its URL.

functional.title: Browse eligible requests
functional.statement: Providers filter open requests by city and category; exact address and contact are withheld.
functional.acceptance: A city/category query excludes nonmatching and assigned/cancelled requests. A provider cannot see their own request as a bidding opportunity.

functional.title: Submit and revise an offer
functional.statement: A provider proposes a positive KZT price, availability, scope and materials/travel inclusions.
functional.acceptance: One active offer per provider/request is maintained. Negative price, own-request bidding and bidding on a closed request are rejected. Revised offers retain an audit event.

functional.title: Compare providers
functional.statement: A customer compares price, schedule, portfolio and review count; sorting is explicit.
functional.acceptance: All active offers on the owned request are shown. Price sort is numeric. A provider without reviews displays No reviews yet instead of a fabricated rating.

functional.title: Accept exactly one offer
functional.statement: Only the request owner or authorised organisation member can select an active offer.
functional.acceptance: Two simultaneous acceptance attempts produce exactly one assignment. A losing attempt returns 409. Repeating a successful request with the same idempotency key returns the same result.

functional.title: Coordinate progress
functional.statement: The assigned provider starts work and marks it ready for confirmation; the customer confirms completion.
functional.acceptance: Only Assigned to In progress to Awaiting confirmation to Completed is accepted. An unrelated user or invalid transition is rejected and no history changes.

functional.title: Handle cancellation
functional.statement: Before assignment the owner can cancel; after assignment either party requests cancellation and the other confirms.
functional.acceptance: Cancellation records actor, reason and time. A disputed cancellation stays pending for moderator review. Cancelled work cannot receive a completed-job review.

functional.title: Private messaging
functional.statement: A chat belongs to a request/offer pair and is accessible to the customer and that provider.
functional.acceptance: A third party cannot read or send messages. After reconnect, the same ordered persisted history appears. Duplicate client message IDs do not create duplicates.

functional.title: Contact sharing and notifications
functional.statement: A user may explicitly share a phone contact; essential events appear in an in-app inbox.
functional.acceptance: Phone contact is absent before opt-in and visible only to the intended participant after sharing. The inbox records offer, acceptance and completion events without exposing private content to others.

functional.title: Suggest a category
functional.statement: The service suggests a category from text and allows confirmation, correction or manual selection.
functional.acceptance: Blank/unsupported text has no forced category. Service failure leaves request creation usable. The final category, suggested category and model version are stored separately.

functional.title: Completed-job reviews
functional.statement: Only the commissioning customer can leave one 1–5 rating and comment for the completed job.
functional.acceptance: Uncompleted, cancelled, unrelated and duplicate reviews are rejected. The displayed mean and count match eligible published reviews. Moderation removals recalculate them.

functional.title: Manage a provider profile
functional.statement: Providers describe skills, service areas and self-uploaded portfolio work.
functional.acceptance: Providers edit only their own profile. Self-declared experience is labelled as such. Uploading a photo never grants a verified-identity badge.

functional.title: Reports and moderation
functional.statement: Users report requests, profiles, messages or reviews; staff record decisions and reasons.
functional.acceptance: Only staff can resolve a report or suspend an account. Resolution retains an audit record and allows an appeal record without deleting original evidence.

functional.title: Organisation-owned requests
functional.statement: An approved member may act for an organisation; ownership survives a member leaving.
functional.acceptance: A member from organisation B cannot edit organisation A requests. Revoked membership immediately blocks new actions. Staff approval records the membership basis without claiming legal certification.

functional.title: Agreement history
functional.statement: The accepted offer snapshot and subsequent agreed changes remain available to both parties.
functional.acceptance: Changing a profile or other offer cannot change the accepted price/scope snapshot. A proposed job change takes effect only after the other party accepts it.

functional.title: Direct payment declaration
functional.statement: Parties may record that payment will occur directly outside the platform.
functional.acceptance: No card number or payment credential is requested. A user declaration is labelled unverified and cannot trigger a platform-paid or escrow status.

nonfunctional.title: Authorization
nonfunctional.statement: All record and media operations enforce ownership/membership on the server.
nonfunctional.acceptance: Pass the complete cross-role and cross-organisation access matrix, including direct IDs and WebSocket sessions.

nonfunctional.title: Data integrity
nonfunctional.statement: Acceptance, status changes and review creation preserve database invariants.
nonfunctional.acceptance: Run concurrent acceptance and repeated-command tests against PostgreSQL; exactly one assignment and at most one customer review per job remain.

nonfunctional.title: Response time
nonfunctional.statement: Under the defined pilot load, ordinary reads remain responsive.
nonfunctional.acceptance: On a documented 2 vCPU/4 GB test server with 10,000 requests and 25 concurrent clients, warm API p95 is at most 800 ms and error rate below 1% over 10 minutes, excluding uploads and ML.

nonfunctional.title: Usability
nonfunctional.statement: Core web journeys work at mobile and desktop widths with keyboard navigation.
nonfunctional.acceptance: At 390 and 1440 px, no horizontal overflow; all key controls have visible focus and labels. At least 80% of 5–8 recruited users finish the core task without intervention.

nonfunctional.title: Privacy and secret handling
nonfunctional.statement: Private contacts, exact addresses and credentials are not public data.
nonfunctional.acceptance: No secrets or real personal research data are committed. Logs redact tokens and private message text. Public request responses omit exact addresses and phone numbers.

nonfunctional.title: Recoverability
nonfunctional.statement: Backups can restore a consistent pilot dataset.
nonfunctional.acceptance: Restore an encrypted backup to a clean environment and verify representative records and attachment references. Proposed pilot RPO 24 h and RTO 4 h are demonstrated, not assumed.

nonfunctional.title: Transport and sessions
nonfunctional.statement: Deployed authenticated traffic uses TLS and bounded sessions.
nonfunctional.acceptance: HTTP redirects to HTTPS, expired/revoked sessions fail, repeated login attempts are limited, and state-changing cookie requests require CSRF protection.

nonfunctional.title: Compatibility
nonfunctional.statement: The core workflow operates across the planned clients.
nonfunctional.acceptance: Run the same acceptance scenario in a named desktop browser, Android emulator/device and iOS simulator/device; record OS/app versions. Mobile success remains untested until Flutter exists.

nonfunctional.title: ML quality and latency
nonfunctional.statement: Category suggestions are optional and must pass a defined release gate.
nonfunctional.acceptance: On a frozen domain test set, macro-F1 is at least 0.80, at least 0.05 above keyword rules, and each evaluated language macro-F1 is at least 0.70. CPU warm p95 prediction time is at most 1 s. Otherwise keep manual selection and report failure.

nonfunctional.title: ML reproducibility
nonfunctional.statement: Dataset provenance, grouped split, preprocessing and model version are reproducible.
nonfunctional.acceptance: A second team member reproduces metrics within 0.01 macro-F1 using the same data hash, split IDs, seed and locked environment. Test data never tune thresholds or vocabulary.

nonfunctional.title: Maintainability and traceability
nonfunctional.statement: Mandatory requirements map to components, tasks and tests.
nonfunctional.acceptance: Every Must requirement has an acceptance record; reviewed changes pass appropriate checks and link to a real YouTrack ID after project setup.

nonfunctional.title: Observability
nonfunctional.statement: Failures and critical lifecycle actions are diagnosable without private content.
nonfunctional.acceptance: A failed acceptance and failed notification can be traced by correlation ID; audit records contain actor, action, target and time, not secrets.
